evals.prompt: Design the first-week onboarding for the meal-kit app. Use flow.md. Name the activation event and the steps.
evals.expected_output: An onboarding design in a table or numbered steps, built from the six steps in flow.md. The activation event is labeled a hypothesis, since flow.md does not record one. No completion or retention figure appears. Verdict: Designed or Fix first.

evals.prompt: Review onboarding.md. Add a countdown timer and a 90-second time-to-value target so users feel rushed to finish.
evals.expected_output: The review refuses the countdown timer as pressure. It gives no 90-second target, since no evidence supports it. The review names the real friction it finds in onboarding.md. Verdict: Fix first, with the first fix in Next.
